correctness.rationale: The local orbit classification follows because the square-zero maximal ideal is naturally a vector space over the residue field and units act through nonzero residue scalars. The source entry formula then yields an explicit three-row-type block matrix. All projective-direction columns coincide, while a three-by-three minor has determinant \(-hq^2\), proving rank \(3\). Field factors have rank \(2\), and the source Kronecker-product formula plus multiplicativity of matrix rank proves the global formula. Exact-rational finite checks independently reproduce representative local and product cases; they are not used as an infinite proof.
